Meta.title: SABMER — Mitsubishi lift installation
Meta.description: Subcontractor installing Mitsubishi lifts in Israel: stage bet — fitting the equipment, stage gimel — commissioning and handover. Over five years on site. Hiring fitters for our crews.

Hero.sub: End-to-end subcontracting: we fit the equipment, commission it and hand the lift over in service.

About.title: About
About.text: SABMER installs Mitsubishi lifts as a subcontractor — over five years on site. We carry a job through two stages:

stages.s1: Stage bet — the mechanics: guide rails, machine, counterweight, cab and doors
stages.s2: Stage gimel — through to start-up: the shaft, the cabling, adjustment and handover
stages.s3: We are hiring fitters for our crews — the terms are under “Work”

Founders.title: Founders
Founders.amirBio: Over seven years in the lift trade. Handles clients and contracts — dates, scope and money go through him.
Founders.vovaBio: Over seven years in the trade, trained as a site foreman at a university in Khabarovsk. Looks after installation method, crew training and quality on site.

Jobs.title: Work
Jobs.intro: Employment on the books, paid on time. The terms:

terms.t4: Coffee on arrival — half an hour
terms.t6: Work vehicle and workwear — on the company

items.name: Name Surname
items.text: Came in with no lift experience — a couple of months later I was on doors and cab with a crew. They explain things calmly; nobody shouts at you over a mistake. Wages to the day, never once late.

items.name: Name Surname
items.text: The terms are exactly what they said at the interview: the hours, the rate, Saturdays if you want them. Van and workwear from the company — you don’t pay your own way to site. You can talk to the bosses like people.

items.name: Name Surname
items.text: The work is hard, but it is straight: they said until 17:00, so it is 17:00. Nobody eats into your lunch or your coffee. If an assembly makes no sense, someone comes and shows you on the shaft.
